It provides a larger and wider field of view, enhancing work efficiency and meeting various needs for office work, entertainment media playback, and gaming. 【USB4】Features a USB4 port with a maximum speed of 40Gbps. Supports 15W PD power delivery, enabling both video and power to be transmitted through a single cable
Large Capacity: DDR5-5600 16 GB x 1 (up to 48 GB x 2) memory + M.2 2280 1TB PCIe 4.0 SSD (up to 4 TB) storage. You can easily customize your storage without worrying about running out of capacity. Compared to passive radiators, the temperature is reduced by 25%. It can easily handle 100% load operations
【Exceptional Connectivity】Supports both wireless and wired connections. Features M.2 2230 Wi-Fi, compatible with high-speed transmission of Bluetooth 5.2 & Wi-Fi 6E, and comes with a 2.5 Gbps LAN port. The traditional Gigabit network has a measured read and write speed of approximately 120 MB/s. The 2.5 Gbps LAN port achieves a 2.5 times faster read and write speed. Whether you're watching videos or gaming, you'll no longer experience bottlenecks. Multiple devices can transmit data simultaneously, effectively reducing delays and improving efficiency
【Rich I/O Interface】RJ45 2.5Gbps x1, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A x 2, USB 2.0 x2, Clear CMOS, Audio jack, USB 4 x 1, HDMI x 1, DP x 1, DC 19V x 1
